Allocation: Create R-{parent M batch}-{sequence} only from the outstanding approved subset.
Before execution: Resolve stable IDs and current metadata; skip already-correct names, held duplicates and collisions. Keep content and extension unchanged.
Completion test: Use autorename=false. Poll the native job, then independently verify ID, exact name/path and size. Save rollback names.
Boundary: Not allocated: remaining approved rename count is not yet known.

Allocation: Create X-{parent D batch}-{sequence} from freshly validated, authorized targets only.
Before execution: Keeper and target must still match by hash, bytes and immediate folder; confirm links, revisions and restrictions. Never delete designated keepers.
Completion test: Poll success; freshly confirm target absence and keeper presence. Preserve failed/held rows and recovery references.
Boundary: Not allocated: 2,015 presence-matched proposals are not 2,015 approved deletions.

Allocation: Create C-{parent B batch}-{sequence} after duplicate disposition and applicable approval.
Before execution: Obtain actual BMP bytes; preserve dimensions and colour profile where possible. Choose an unoccupied approved destination, not a blind stem match.
Completion test: Encode real high-quality JPEG, upload, retrieve/decode the uploaded result and record source/replacement IDs and dimensions. Retain original BMPs.
Boundary: Capability dependent. Do not report a renamed extension as a conversion.

Allocation: Create Q-{parent C batch}-{sequence} only after replacements have passed verification.
Before execution: Resolve source and replacement again, retain lossless source/recovery information according to the approved policy, and confirm deletion authority.
Completion test: Poll removal; independently confirm original absence and verified replacement presence. Save exact lineage and recovery evidence.
Boundary: Separate from C: upload success alone never authorizes source removal.

Allocation: Create G-{parent F or I batch}-{sequence} only after naming/identity approval.
Before execution: Resolve folder ID, prove destination is free, check affected children and pause conflicting file operations.
Completion test: Poll completion; freshly verify folder and child IDs/paths. Rebase pending child manifests before any R/X/C action.
Boundary: Never rename a folder solely to replace a word such as diptych without evidence.

Allocation: Create V-{family code}-{sequence} from the post-cleanup retained/replacement asset set.
Before execution: Review actual media including group scenes and assets outside in-situ folders; follow validated conversion mappings and skip documented disposed IDs.
Completion test: Record visible individual design, finish, components, image type and coverage. Distinguish actual installation, group-only, generated, detail/process and unresolved.
Boundary: Dynamic count. Review every retained asset needed for exhaustive coverage; no filename-only coverage claims.

Allocation: Create T-{family code}-{sequence}; repeat until that family's retained-ID and exception sets are exhausted.
Before execution: Resolve all naming, duplicate, BMP and visual outcomes; check folder changes, keepers, replacements and held exceptions.
Completion test: Save a reconciled family ledger; record any changes since the earlier snapshot. A partial family must remain partial.
Boundary: Repeat for all 64 baseline family scopes; do not assume their current locations.

Allocation: One closing task after all family checks, using paginated reads and saved checkpoints.
Before execution: All baseline IDs and subsequent replacements must be accounted for; keep unresolved cases explicit. Capture new/externally moved files separately.
Completion test: Reconcile every original ID to retained/renamed, verified replacement, evidenced intentional deletion, relocation or unresolved. Export final workbook and report.
Boundary: A final fresh inventory is needed; the completed starting census is not replayed as unfinished work.
